basic_info.description: Wonderful opportunity to own this beautiful building in Central Richmond.  This property has been in the same family since it was constructed.  Large three bedroom, two bathroom flats that include a spacious living room the fireplace, formal dining room, breakfast room, kitchen and in unit laundry.  2-3 car parking plus bonus and storage space on lower level plus a yard.  Great location by Golden Gate Park, public transportation and shopping.
